milestone_events.event: US 25% duties on global steel, aluminum, and auto imports
US IEEPA Liberation Day tariffs: 10% universal baseline + country-specific reciprocal duties; retaliation from China & Canada; 90-day pause on non-retaliators
FOMC cuts -25bps to 3.75-4.00%; US federal shutdown cancels Oct 2025 CPI report
US Supreme Court strikes down IEEPA emergency tariffs in Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump
Strait of Hormuz shipping/conflict crisis; Middle East crude shut-ins peak at 10.9M bpd in May 2026; Brent surges from $70.89 (Feb) to $103.13 (Mar), $117.29 (Apr), $107.14 (May)
US administration pivots to Section 301 and Section 338 tariff authorities (25-50% targeted duties e.g. Brazil, Canada), triggering new retaliation
FOMC reverses easing cycle and HIKES +25bps to 3.75-4.00% (first hike since 2023) due to sticky 3.7% inflation and energy rebound; Brent rebounds to $114.16 (Sep) and $123.93 (Oct 2026)
FOMC holds 3.75-4.00% (10-2 vote, 2 hawkish dissents for another +25bps hike)
